snippet.title: Agents of Mayhem | Introducing Lazarus | PS4
snippet.description:
A trial serum turned Lazarus into a deadly blend of woman and machine. She’s the peak of evolution, and she’s ready to challenge anyone (or anything) that says otherwise. 

Lazarus Agent pack available now!
